profiles.common: identical selected point returns; native deskew retained; native extra downsampling disabled

truth: PhysX rigid-body pose -> mounted IMU pose, per physics tick; no estimator feedback
point_identity: Identical raw returns, intensity, and per-point timestamps before each native deskewer; corrected XYZ may differ with estimator state.
ground_truth: Direct PhysX rigid-body pose at 200 simulated Hz, converted to mounted IMU; never an EKF output
controller: Independent PhysX GT input to PX4, neither measured LIO feeds flight
lidar_model: RTX frame-coherent snapshots at render rate, 100 ms Livox-compatible packets; not continuous rolling Mid360
common_preprocessing: One real return per 0.5 m raw-frame voxel; preserve endpoints; same XYZ and per-point times for both
patches: FAST deskew time origin and first-point handling
replay_availability: Preserve observed scan delay: max(scan-end timestamp, most recent IMU timestamp at bag receipt); IMU scheduled at acquisition time; 1x
